about: Period photographs for the cumhuriyet mod. Keys are the game's kind.id ids (char.*, comp.* for Yaver cards, card.* for Entrika, crisis.*, term.hizmet / term.hiyanet for the Zafer and Hezimet Telgraf cards, ui.frieze for frieze backdrops). Each candidate: file (in this folder, long edge <= 1600 px, JPEG ~80%), size [w,h], source_url (the image), source_page (its Wikimedia Commons file page), licence (as stated on the file page, with author and date where given), note (who or what is in frame, plus concerns), focus [x,y] = subject centre as fractions, usable as CSS object-position. First candidate is the pick. status: found, weak (usable but small, off-period or not the exact subject) or placeholder.

not_covered.amb.*: Emel cards are drawn art by design; no photographs.
not_covered.taraf.*: Taraf cards are drawn art (rising sun, dagger and shadow); no real person appears on them.
not_covered.cut-outs: Character cut-outs wait for the shared cut-out tool from the skin refactor. Portraits were picked for a clean head and shoulders.

rules: Real people appear only in real photographs, never generated or retouched. Mustafa Kemal appears only on char.suleyman (his card, seat niche and the frieze centre): no Entrika, Buhran or Telgraf still shows him. No Turkish flag on Hezimet or Hain art.
rights: Public-domain and CC BY-SA 4.0 files from Wikimedia Commons (the Albert Kahn autochromes by Frédéric Gadmer are CC BY-SA 4.0: credit "Musée départemental Albert-Kahn, Frédéric Gadmer" and keep the licence). Private, non-commercial use among friends.
